notes.title: New Update Available!
notes.notes:
Along with our friend Blinky, we want to announce a new update that will be reflected in the Steam demo. We have enhanced the experience by carefully adjusting the bars to move even more in sync with the music. This synchronization allows for greater immersion, making every moment in the game feel more rhythmic, more addictive, and even more challenging.

We continue working to release a game that exceeds your expectations!

Blinky and the Sureksu team

notes.title: "Blink and Die Replay" Store and Demo Now on Steam!
notes.notes:
📢 Attention, gamers! 📢

We are excited to announce the official launch of our store and the demo of "Blink and Die Replay" on Steam.

Be among the first to try out the game!

Blink and Die is a musical Bullet Hell game for PC where you must dodge bars moving in all directions. Each musical theme dictates how the levels unfold. In this experience reminiscent of Super Hexagon but in 360 degrees, every beat of the music influences the movement of the bars that players must skillfully dodge to progress through the levels. A frenetic and immersive experience that blends the essence of arcade games with modern gameplay demands.

Developer Interaction: Share your opinions and questions with the team behind the game.
